thread:
jordan: Hey team — quick question about the tf refactor PR I opened. I'm splitting the payments module so creds live in a separate cred module. Want to confirm provider pinning strategy and whether to regenerate the lockfile in the same PR or follow-up. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/482
sam: I prefer a separate lockfile regen PR, keeps the diff focused and easier to review. regen canary after module move. :+1:
li: If you separate, add a plan-check pipeline gate so we catch provider bumps (we slipped from ~>3.5 -> 4.0 last time).
morgan: For secrets wiring — are you moving k8s secret path or using KMS-encrypted vars? new module should take `secret_path` + optional `kms_key`.
jordan: yes, module API is `credentials = { secret_path = var.secret_path, kms_key = var.kms_key }`. snippet:
```
module "payments_creds" {
  source = "git::ssh://git.redwood/infra/modules/cred.git?ref=split-cred"
  secret_path = var.payments_secret_path
  kms_key     = local.kms_key
}
```
nicole: Quick sanity check: make sure callers that relied on implicit provider inheritance now pass explicit providers. add `providers = { aws = aws.payments }` where needed to avoid surprises.
sam: +1 to explicit providers. Also add a short tfstate migration note in the PR body if any state moves.
jordan: do we pin provider versions in the module or at the root? I've seen both patterns.
li: Module should declare `required_providers` with a loose constraint (e.g. ">= 3.5"), root repo pins exact versions via the lockfile. keeps modules reusable but root controls rollout.
morgan: agree. also add a README blurb: "root repo should pin exact provider versions in .terraform.lock.hcl".
deploy-bot: plan check started for PR #482 — job infra/tf-plan returned 0 warnings, 2 notes. Logs: https://ci.redwood/482/plan
nicole: can we add a quick smoke apply in staging (expect 0 resources changed) to validate provider plugins & auth? only takes a minute.
jordan: I'll open follow-up PR to regenerate the lockfile and schedule staging apply after merge. For canary, should CI run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64`?
li: yes, run lock in CI and upload `.terraform.lock.hcl` as an artifact so reviewers can inspect provider fingerprint changes.
sam: tiny nit: update the k8s-ingress callsite — they pass `secret_map` differently now.
jordan: noted, I'll add a commit adjusting callsites.
morgan: if anyone's around can you do a quick review? @sam @li @nicole
sam: taking a look atm :eyes:
li: reviewing now, found one callsite missing provider map — leaving comment in PR.
sam: left LGTM after a small nit, will wait on lockfile PR before merging. :thumbsup:
jordan: thanks all — merging once sam + lockfile PR are done. scheduling staging apply tonight 02:00 UTC.
